description: Create an empty analytics dashboard in an org and return dashboard_id and dashboard_url. Then save charts with analytics_chart_create and add_to_dashboard, or add saved charts with analytics_dashboard_add_chart. Layout: the dashboard is a grid of 3 columns, charts go in the order of their position and wrap into rows. width_size 1 = a third, 2 = two thirds, 3 = a full row. Keep the sum of widths in every row equal to 3 (3, 2+1, 1+2, 1+1+1), otherwise a row has an empty hole. Good widths: a line or bars over time 2 or 3, a funnel 2 or 3 (up to 4 steps fit without scrolling at width 1), TOTAL bars and retention 1 or 2.

dashboard_description.description: One line about what the dashboard shows

org_id.description: The analytics org ID from analytics_orgs_list (uses MCP_ANALYTICS_ORG_ID env if not provided)

name: analytics_dashboard_create
